Leverage threat intelligence feeds and reputation services to identify known fast flux domains and IP addresses
Implement anomaly detection systems for DNS query logs to identify domains with high entropy or IP diversity
Analyze TTL values in DNS records to detect fast flux domains with unusually low TTL
Review DNS resolution for inconsistent geolocation to identify malicious fast flux domains
Use flow data to identify large-scale communications with numerous different IP addresses over short periods
Develop fast flux detection algorithms to identify anomalous traffic patterns
Monitor for signs of phishing activities and correlate with fast flux activity
Implement customer transparency and share information about detected fast flux activity
Block access to domains identified as using fast flux through non-routable DNS responses or firewall rules
Sinkhole malicious fast flux domains to capture and analyze traffic
Block IP addresses known to be associated with malicious fast flux networks
Block traffic to and from domains or IP addresses with poor reputations associated with malicious fast flux
Increase logging and monitoring of DNS traffic and network communications
Implement automated alerting mechanisms to respond swiftly to detected fast flux patterns
Share detected fast flux indicators with trusted partners and threat intelligence communities
Participate in public and private information-sharing programs to stay informed about emerging fast flux TTPs
Implement employee awareness and training programs to identify and respond to phishing attempts
Develop policies and procedures to manage and contain phishing incidents facilitated by fast flux networks
